title: चितवनका सहकारी पीडितले मन्त्री रावललाई रुँदै भने- सहकारीले खाएको हाम्रो रकम कहिले फिर्ता हुन्छ ?
content:
चितवन । भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी, सङ्घीय मामिला तथा सामान्य प्रशासन मन्त्री प्रतिभा रावललाई यहाँका सहकारी पीडितले आउँदो चुनावअघि आफ्ना सहकारीमा डुबेको रकम फिर्ता गरिदिन अनुरोध गरेका छन् । उनीहरुले मजदुरी गरेर जम्मा गरेको रकम, घर जग्गा बेचेर, छोराछोरीको कमाइ समेत बटुलेर जम्मा गरेको रकम नहुँदा आफूहरु बिचल्लीमा परेको भन्दै आउँदो चुनावअघि रकम फिर्ता गराइदिन अनुरोध गरेका हुन् । सनराइज बचत तथा ऋण सहकारी संस्थामा २०७१ सालदेखि ठेलामा व्यपार गरेको पैसा बचत गरेकी सुशीला कुमारी केसीले सहकारीले पैसा खाएको पाँच वर्ष बितिसक्दा पनि सरकारी निकायबाट उठाउन पहल नभएको दुखेको गरिन् । उनले १४ कठ्ठा चितवनको जमिन बेचेको रकम समेत सहकारीमा जम्मा गरेकी थिइन् । सहकारी सञ्चालकले रकम हिनामिना गरेर भागेपछि उठाइदिन राज्यका कुनै निकायले पनि सहयोग नगरेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘जीवनभरी दुःख गरेको रकम गुम्दा आफ्नो घरसमेत भएन । अर्काको घरमा कोच्चिएर बस्नुपरेको छ’, उनले मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाइन्, ‘पैसा आउला आउला भनेर ५ वर्ष झुलाइसके । अहिले प्रहरीमा गएपनि रुँदै आउनुपरेको छ । महानगर गयौँ भने बाघझैँ झम्टिन्छन् ।’ जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय चितवनले गराएको सहकारी पीडितसँगको अन्तरक्रियामा ८४ वर्षका कृष्ण शर्मा सापकोटाले पनि रुँदै आफ्नो दुःख सुनाएका थिए । बुढेसकालमा आरामसँग बसूँला भनेर ४ कोठाको घर बेचेर शिवशिखर सहकारीमा रकम जम्मा गरेका उनले सुनाए । तर, सहकारी सञ्चालकले रकम हिनामिना गरेर अहिले सहकारी बन्द छ । शर्माले भने, ‘बृद्धाअवस्थामा आरामसँग बसुँला भनेर घर बेचेको पैसा, पेन्सन सबै गरेर शिव शिखर सहकारी संस्थामा राखेँ । मेरो एक्लै २ करोड ४० लाख र छोरा नातिनातीनाको सहित ३ करोड बढी रकम डुबेको छ । अहिले न सावाँ न ब्याज भइयो !’ उनले आफ्नो मुटुको भल्व ब्याट्री राखेर चलाएको, श्रीमतीको पनि त्यस्तै अवस्था रहेको समेत बताए । बुढेसकालमा राम्रोसँग जीवन चलाउँला भनेर राखेको पैसा डुबेर बुढेसकालमा उपचार गर्ने रकम समेत नहुने अवस्था आएको मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाए । त्यसैगरी सहकारी पीडितहरुका सञ्जालको संयोजक समेत रहेका शालीग्राम दवाडीले आफू सहित साहारा सहकारी पीडितहरु त झनै दोहोरो समस्यामा रहेको दुखेसो गरे । राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका सभापति रवि लामिछाने जोडिएको कारण साहारा सहकारी पीडितको अवस्थाको सुनुवाइ हुन समस्या परेको उनको गुनासो छ । “साहारा सहकारीको बजारमा भएको रकम, गोर्खा मिडियामा गएको रकम, हामीले रोक्का गरेको ललितपुरसहित विभिन्न ठाउँमा रहेको जग्गा लगायतबाट रकम उठाउन सकिने अवस्था छ’, उप्रनले मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाउँदै भने, ‘तर माननीय रवि लामिछाने जोडिएको मुद्दा भएकाले कर्मचारीले संकटग्रस्त समेत घोषणा नगरिदिँदा रकम उठाउने निकाय नै भएन । हामीले दुःख पायौँ ।’ उनले प्रहरीले पनि अहिले सहकारी पीडितको उजुरी नलिएको दुखेसो समेत गरेका थिए । चितवनका प्रहरी प्रमुख एसपी रामेश्वर पौडेलले सङ्घीय सरकारले सहकारी सम्बन्धि कानून बनाउँदै भएकोले अहिले उजुरी नलिन निर्देशन दिएको हुनाले उजुरी नलिएको बताए । कार्यक्रममा उपस्थित भएका सहकारी पीडितहरुले आउँदो चुनावअघि नै सहकारी पीडितको पैसा फिर्ता गरिदिन अनुरोध गरेका थिए । उनीहरुमध्ये अधिकांशले सरकारले बाँडेको २५ हजार रुपैयाँ पनि नपाएको समेत गुनासो गरेका थिए । कार्यक्रममा सहकारी पीडितका कुरा सुनेपछि मन्त्री रावलले कानून बनाएर सहकारी पीडितको समस्या सरकारले समाधान गर्ने प्रतिवद्दता जनाइन् । उनले सहकारीमा पैसा बचत गर्नु नागरिकको गल्ती होइन भन्नेकुरा सरकार स्पष्ट भएको बताउँदै उनले भनिन्, ‘अदालतमा विचाराधीन मुद्दा छिटो टुङ्गो लागेपछि प्रकृया अगाडि बढाउन सक्ने भएकाले सर्वोच्च अदालतमा न्यायधीशलाई भेटेर सहकारी मुद्दा अगाडि बढाउन विशेष डेस्क बनाइदिन अनुरोध गरेका छौँ ।” हामी रकम फिर्ता हुने आश्वासन होइन जिम्मेवारी लिएर सङ्घीय सरकारले काम गर्नेगरि कानून तर्जुमा भइरहेको जानकारी गराइन् । रकम फिर्ता गर्न भने समन्वय गर्नुपर्ने भएकोले समय लाग्नसक्ने उनको भनाइ छ । Chitwan. Cooperative victims here have requested Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration, Pratibha Rawal, to return the money sunk into their cooperatives before the upcoming elections. They have requested that the money be returned before the upcoming elections, saying that they are in trouble because they have not saved the money they saved by working, selling their houses and land, and even collecting the earnings of their children. Sushila Kumari KC, who has been saving money from her cart business at Sunrise Savings and Credit Cooperative since 2071 BS, lamented that even after five years of the cooperative taking the money, there has been no initiative from the government agency to collect it. She had also deposited the money she had sold for 14 kaththas of Chitwan land in the cooperative. She says that no state agency has helped her recover the money after the cooperative director embezzled the money and fled. 'I lost the money I had suffered for my entire life, and I have to live in someone else's house,' she told Minister Rawal. 'I have been waiting for 5 years for the money to come. Now, even when I go to the police, I have to come crying. If I go to the metropolis, they pounce like tigers.' In an interaction with cooperative victims organized by the District Administration Office, Chitwan, 84-year-old Krishna Sharma Sapkota also cried and expressed his grief. He said that he had sold his 4-room house and deposited the money in the Shiv Shikhar Cooperative so that he could live comfortably in his old age. However, the cooperative's director embezzled the money and now the cooperative is closed. Sharma said, 'I sold the house and put all my pension money in the Shiv Shikhar Cooperative to live comfortably in my old age. I alone have invested 24 million rupees and more than 30 million rupees including my son and grandson. Now there is no interest or return!' He also said that his heart valve is operated by a battery and that his wife is also in a similar situation. He told Minister Rawal that the money he had saved to live a good life in his old age had been drained and he was not even able to afford treatment in his old age. Similarly, Shaligram Dawadi, who is also the coordinator of the cooperative victims' network, lamented that the Sahara cooperative victims, including himself, are in even more trouble. He complained that due to the involvement of National Independent Party President Ravi Lamichhane, there is a problem in hearing the situation of the Sahara cooperative victims. "There is a situation where the money can be collected from the Sahara Cooperative's market, the money that went to Gorkha Media, the land that we have blocked, including in Lalitpur," Upron told Minister Rawal, "but since the case involving Honorable Ravi Lamichhane was connected, the employees did not even declare it in crisis, so there was no body to collect the money. We were sad." He also lamented that the police are not taking complaints from cooperative victims at the moment. Chitwan Police Chief SP Rameshwor Poudel said that the complaints are not being taken because the federal government has instructed not to take complaints at the moment as it is making a law related to cooperatives. The cooperative victims who attended the program requested that the cooperative victims' money be returned before the upcoming elections. Most of them complained that they had not even received the 25,000 rupees distributed by the government. After listening to the cooperative victims at the program, Minister Rawal pledged that the government would solve the problems of cooperative victims by enacting a law. Stating that the government has made it clear that saving money in cooperatives is not the fault of the citizen, she said, "We have requested the Supreme Court judge to set up a special desk to take forward the cooperative cases as the process can be taken forward after the pending cases in the court are resolved quickly." She informed that the federal government is taking responsibility and is not promising that the money will be returned, but that a law is being formulated to ensure that it will work. She said that it may take time to return the money as coordination is required.

चितवन । भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी, सङ्घीय मामिला तथा सामान्य प्रशासन मन्त्री प्रतिभा रावललाई यहाँका सहकारी पीडितले आउँदो चुनावअघि आफ्ना सहकारीमा डुबेको रकम फिर्ता गरिदिन अनुरोध गरेका छन् ।

उनीहरुले मजदुरी गरेर जम्मा गरेको रकम, घर जग्गा बेचेर, छोराछोरीको कमाइ समेत बटुलेर जम्मा गरेको रकम नहुँदा आफूहरु बिचल्लीमा परेको भन्दै आउँदो चुनावअघि रकम फिर्ता गराइदिन अनुरोध गरेका हुन् ।

सनराइज बचत तथा ऋण सहकारी संस्थामा २०७१ सालदेखि ठेलामा व्यपार गरेको पैसा बचत गरेकी सुशीला कुमारी केसीले सहकारीले पैसा खाएको पाँच वर्ष बितिसक्दा पनि सरकारी निकायबाट उठाउन पहल नभएको दुखेको गरिन् ।

उनले १४ कठ्ठा चितवनको जमिन बेचेको रकम समेत सहकारीमा जम्मा गरेकी थिइन् । सहकारी सञ्चालकले रकम हिनामिना गरेर भागेपछि उठाइदिन राज्यका कुनै निकायले पनि सहयोग नगरेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘जीवनभरी दुःख गरेको रकम गुम्दा आफ्नो घरसमेत भएन । अर्काको घरमा कोच्चिएर बस्नुपरेको छ’, उनले मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाइन्, ‘पैसा आउला आउला भनेर ५ वर्ष झुलाइसके । अहिले प्रहरीमा गएपनि रुँदै आउनुपरेको छ । महानगर गयौँ भने बाघझैँ झम्टिन्छन् ।’

जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय चितवनले गराएको सहकारी पीडितसँगको अन्तरक्रियामा ८४ वर्षका कृष्ण शर्मा सापकोटाले पनि रुँदै आफ्नो दुःख सुनाएका थिए ।

बुढेसकालमा आरामसँग बसूँला भनेर ४ कोठाको घर बेचेर शिवशिखर सहकारीमा रकम जम्मा गरेका उनले सुनाए । तर, सहकारी सञ्चालकले रकम हिनामिना गरेर अहिले सहकारी बन्द छ । शर्माले भने, ‘बृद्धाअवस्थामा आरामसँग बसुँला भनेर घर बेचेको पैसा, पेन्सन सबै गरेर शिव शिखर सहकारी संस्थामा राखेँ । मेरो एक्लै २ करोड ४० लाख र छोरा नातिनातीनाको सहित ३ करोड बढी रकम डुबेको छ । अहिले न सावाँ न ब्याज भइयो !’

उनले आफ्नो मुटुको भल्व ब्याट्री राखेर चलाएको, श्रीमतीको पनि त्यस्तै अवस्था रहेको समेत बताए । बुढेसकालमा राम्रोसँग जीवन चलाउँला भनेर राखेको पैसा डुबेर बुढेसकालमा उपचार गर्ने रकम समेत नहुने अवस्था आएको मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाए ।

त्यसैगरी सहकारी पीडितहरुका सञ्जालको संयोजक समेत रहेका शालीग्राम दवाडीले आफू सहित साहारा सहकारी पीडितहरु त झनै दोहोरो समस्यामा रहेको दुखेसो गरे । राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका सभापति रवि लामिछाने जोडिएको कारण साहारा सहकारी पीडितको अवस्थाको सुनुवाइ हुन समस्या परेको उनको गुनासो छ ।

“साहारा सहकारीको बजारमा भएको रकम, गोर्खा मिडियामा गएको रकम, हामीले रोक्का गरेको ललितपुरसहित विभिन्न ठाउँमा रहेको जग्गा लगायतबाट रकम उठाउन सकिने अवस्था छ’, उप्रनले मन्त्री रावललाई सुनाउँदै भने, ‘तर माननीय रवि लामिछाने जोडिएको मुद्दा भएकाले कर्मचारीले संकटग्रस्त समेत घोषणा नगरिदिँदा रकम उठाउने निकाय नै भएन । हामीले दुःख पायौँ ।’

उनले प्रहरीले पनि अहिले सहकारी पीडितको उजुरी नलिएको दुखेसो समेत गरेका थिए । चितवनका प्रहरी प्रमुख एसपी रामेश्वर पौडेलले सङ्घीय सरकारले सहकारी सम्बन्धि कानून बनाउँदै भएकोले अहिले उजुरी नलिन निर्देशन दिएको हुनाले उजुरी नलिएको बताए ।

कार्यक्रममा उपस्थित भएका सहकारी पीडितहरुले आउँदो चुनावअघि नै सहकारी पीडितको पैसा फिर्ता गरिदिन अनुरोध गरेका थिए । उनीहरुमध्ये अधिकांशले सरकारले बाँडेको २५ हजार रुपैयाँ पनि नपाएको समेत गुनासो गरेका थिए ।

कार्यक्रममा सहकारी पीडितका कुरा सुनेपछि मन्त्री रावलले कानून बनाएर सहकारी पीडितको समस्या सरकारले समाधान गर्ने प्रतिवद्दता जनाइन् । उनले सहकारीमा पैसा बचत गर्नु नागरिकको गल्ती होइन भन्नेकुरा सरकार स्पष्ट भएको बताउँदै उनले भनिन्, ‘अदालतमा विचाराधीन मुद्दा छिटो टुङ्गो लागेपछि प्रकृया अगाडि बढाउन सक्ने भएकाले सर्वोच्च अदालतमा न्यायधीशलाई भेटेर सहकारी मुद्दा अगाडि बढाउन विशेष डेस्क बनाइदिन अनुरोध गरेका छौँ ।”

हामी रकम फिर्ता हुने आश्वासन होइन जिम्मेवारी लिएर सङ्घीय सरकारले काम गर्नेगरि कानून तर्जुमा भइरहेको जानकारी गराइन् । रकम फिर्ता गर्न भने समन्वय गर्नुपर्ने भएकोले समय लाग्नसक्ने उनको भनाइ छ ।

Chitwan. Cooperative victims here have requested Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration, Pratibha Rawal, to return the money sunk into their cooperatives before the upcoming elections. They have requested that the money be returned before the upcoming elections, saying that they are in trouble because they have not saved the money they saved by working, selling their houses and land, and even collecting the earnings of their children. Sushila Kumari KC, who has been saving money from her cart business at Sunrise Savings and Credit Cooperative since 2071 BS, lamented that even after five years of the cooperative taking the money, there has been no initiative from the government agency to collect it. She had also deposited the money she had sold for 14 kaththas of Chitwan land in the cooperative. She says that no state agency has helped her recover the money after the cooperative director embezzled the money and fled. 'I lost the money I had suffered for my entire life, and I have to live in someone else's house,' she told Minister Rawal. 'I have been waiting for 5 years for the money to come. Now, even when I go to the police, I have to come crying. If I go to the metropolis, they pounce like tigers.' In an interaction with cooperative victims organized by the District Administration Office, Chitwan, 84-year-old Krishna Sharma Sapkota also cried and expressed his grief. He said that he had sold his 4-room house and deposited the money in the Shiv Shikhar Cooperative so that he could live comfortably in his old age. However, the cooperative's director embezzled the money and now the cooperative is closed. Sharma said, 'I sold the house and put all my pension money in the Shiv Shikhar Cooperative to live comfortably in my old age. I alone have invested 24 million rupees and more than 30 million rupees including my son and grandson. Now there is no interest or return!' He also said that his heart valve is operated by a battery and that his wife is also in a similar situation. He told Minister Rawal that the money he had saved to live a good life in his old age had been drained and he was not even able to afford treatment in his old age. Similarly, Shaligram Dawadi, who is also the coordinator of the cooperative victims' network, lamented that the Sahara cooperative victims, including himself, are in even more trouble. He complained that due to the involvement of National Independent Party President Ravi Lamichhane, there is a problem in hearing the situation of the Sahara cooperative victims. "There is a situation where the money can be collected from the Sahara Cooperative's market, the money that went to Gorkha Media, the land that we have blocked, including in Lalitpur," Upron told Minister Rawal, "but since the case involving Honorable Ravi Lamichhane was connected, the employees did not even declare it in crisis, so there was no body to collect the money. We were sad." He also lamented that the police are not taking complaints from cooperative victims at the moment. Chitwan Police Chief SP Rameshwor Poudel said that the complaints are not being taken because the federal government has instructed not to take complaints at the moment as it is making a law related to cooperatives. The cooperative victims who attended the program requested that the cooperative victims' money be returned before the upcoming elections. Most of them complained that they had not even received the 25,000 rupees distributed by the government. After listening to the cooperative victims at the program, Minister Rawal pledged that the government would solve the problems of cooperative victims by enacting a law. Stating that the government has made it clear that saving money in cooperatives is not the fault of the citizen, she said, "We have requested the Supreme Court judge to set up a special desk to take forward the cooperative cases as the process can be taken forward after the pending cases in the court are resolved quickly." She informed that the federal government is taking responsibility and is not promising that the money will be returned, but that a law is being formulated to ensure that it will work. She said that it may take time to return the money as coordination is required.
